content:
[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling>=1.27.0"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "policy-engine"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "AI-driven Policy Simulation System using JAX and Unified Data Fabric"
requires-python = ">=3.14,<3.15"
dependencies = [
  # Core Math & Sim
  "jax>=0.4.20",
  "jaxlib>=0.4.20",
  "equinox>=0.11.0",
  "diffrax>=0.5.0",
  "optax>=0.1.9",
  "jaxtyping>=0.2.25",
  # Data Fabric
  "duckdb>=0.9.2",
  "pyarrow>=14.0.0",
  "aiohttp>=3.9.0",
  "pandas>=2.1.0",
  "openpyxl>=3.1.0",
  "xlrd>=2.0.1",
  "odfpy>=1.4.1",
  "pypdf>=5.5.0",
  "openai",
  "pydantic>=2.12.0",
  "pydantic-settings>=2.0.0",
  "click>=8.1.7",
  "tiktoken",
  "orjson>=3.10.0",
  "zstandard>=0.23.0",
  "opt_einsum>=3.4.0",
  # Observability
  "opentelemetry-api>=1.20.0",
  "opentelemetry-sdk>=1.20.0",
  "opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-grpc>=1.20.0",
  "opentelemetry-exporter-prometheus>=0.41b0",
  # Orchestration
  "langgraph>=0.0.10",
  "langchain>=0.1.0",
  "pymoo>=0.6.0",
  # Utils
  "python-dotenv>=1.0.0",
  "cryptography>=42.0.0",
  "loguru>=0.7.2",
  "packaging>=23.0",
  "chex>=0.1.91",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
core = []
# Native HNSW remains available to vector-search/research installs; core CI needs no compiler.
vector-search = ["hnswlib==0.8.0"]
lint = [
  "basedpyright>=1.34.0",
  "mypy>=1.19.1",
  "pre-commit>=4.5.1",
  "ruff>=0.14.10",
  "types-requests>=2.32.4.20250913",
]
docs = ["mkdocs>=1.6.0", "mkdocs-material>=9.6.0", "mkdocstrings[python]>=0.30.0"]
notebooks = ["jupyterlab>=4.0.0", "matplotlib>=3.8.0", "seaborn>=0.13.0"]
mutation = ["mutmut>=2.0"]
agent-sim = ["plotly>=6.5.0", "streamlit>=1.52.2"]
apple-metal = ["jax-metal>=0.1.1; sys_platform == 'darwin'"]
kuzu = ["kuzu>=0.1.0"]
analytics = [
  "scipy>=1.11.0",
  "statsmodels>=0.14.0",
  "linearmodels>=5.0",
  "pandas>=2.0.0",
  "ruptures>=1.1.10",
  "arch>=8.0.0",
]
ml = ["scikit-learn>=1.6.0", "lifelines>=0.30.0", "mapie>=1.0.0"]
# Compatibility alias: the core JAX stack already lives in the base install.
# Accelerator-specific backends such as Apple Metal stay opt-in extras.
deep-learning = []
optimization-advanced = ["cvxpy>=1.8.1"]
bayesian = ["numpyro>=0.20.0", "arviz>=1.0.0"]
sensitivity = ["SALib>=1.5,<2.0", "scipy>=1.11.0"]
# Keep DoWhy in a separate compatibility extra: 0.13 hard-pins cvxpy<1.5,
# which conflicts with the modern optimization stack used elsewhere.
causal = ["policy-engine[causal-core]", "policy-engine[causal-dowhy]"]
causal-core = [
  # EconML currently resolves to a scikit-learn build path without ready
  # Python 3.14 wheels in the verified docs environment.
  "econml>=0.16; python_version < '3.14'",
]
causal-dowhy = ["dowhy>=0.13,<0.14; python_version < '3.13'", "cvxpy<1.5; python_version < '3.13'"]
causal-bcf = ["stochtree>=0.1.0"]
causal-nuisance = ["lightgbm>=4.0", "zepid>=0.9"]
causal-discovery = ["tigramite>=5.2", "causal-learn>=0.1.3.8"]
causal-discovery-scale = ["dagma>=1.1.1"]
causal-symbolic = ["y0>=0.2,<0.3"]
causal-symbolic-y0 = ["y0>=0.2,<0.3"]
causal-symbolic-r = ["rpy2>=3.5,<4.0"]
causal-full = [
  "econml>=0.16; python_version < '3.14'",
  "dowhy>=0.13,<0.14; python_version < '3.13'",
  "cvxpy<1.5; python_version < '3.13'",
  "lightgbm>=4.0",
  "zepid>=0.9",
  "y0>=0.2,<0.3",
]
table-extraction = ["marker-pdf>=0.3.0"]
solvers = ["ortools>=9.8", "pulp>=2.8"]
methods-full = [
  "policy-engine[analytics]",
  "policy-engine[causal-core]",
  "policy-engine[solvers]",
  "policy-engine[ml]",
  "policy-engine[optimization-advanced]",
  "policy-engine[bayesian]",
]
methods-milestone2 = [
  "policy-engine[analytics]",
  "policy-engine[ml]",
  "policy-engine[optimization-advanced]",
  "policy-engine[solvers]",
]
methods-milestone3 = ["policy-engine[methods-milestone2]"]
methods-milestone4 = ["policy-engine[methods-milestone3]", "policy-engine[bayesian]"]
observability = ["prometheus-client>=0.17.0"]
runtime-http = ["fastapi>=0.109.0", "uvicorn[standard]>=0.27.0", "httpx>=0.27.0", "PyJWT>=2.8.0"]
runtime = [
  "policy-engine[runtime-http]",
  "policy-engine[observability]",
  "policy-engine[structured-logging]",
]
multi-tenant = ["policy-engine[runtime-http]", "psycopg[binary]>=3.1.0", "asyncpg>=0.29.0"]
security = [
  "httpx>=0.27.0",
  "boto3>=1.34.0",
  "sigstore>=3.0.0",
  "presidio-analyzer>=2.2.0",
  "presidio-anonymizer>=2.2.0",
  "spacy>=3.7.0",
]
rag = ["faiss-cpu>=1.7.4,<2.0"]
rag-local = ["sentence-transformers>=2.2.0,<3.0", "onnxruntime>=1.18.0,<2.0"]
academic-skg = ["pypdf>=5.5.0"]
sandbox = ["RestrictedPython>=7.0,<8.0"]
shapesafe = ["beartype>=0.18.0"]
hotreload = ["watchfiles>=0.21.0"]
research = [
  "policy-engine[vector-search]",
  "policy-engine[analytics]",
  "policy-engine[bayesian]",
  "policy-engine[causal-discovery]",
  "policy-engine[causal-discovery-scale]",
  "policy-engine[causal-full]",
  "policy-engine[ml]",
  "policy-engine[optimization-advanced]",
  "policy-engine[sensitivity]",
  "policy-engine[solvers]",
  "policy-engine[academic-skg]",
]
agent-quality = ["faiss-cpu>=1.7.4,<2.0", "RestrictedPython>=7.0,<8.0"]
test = [
  "pytest>=7.4.0",
  "pytest-asyncio>=0.23.0",
  "pytest-benchmark>=4.0.0",
  "pytest-xdist>=3.6.1",
  "hypothesis>=6.0.0",
  "jsonschema[format-nongpl]>=4.25.1",
  "rdflib>=7.0.0",
  "policy-engine[runtime-http]",
]
dev = [
  "policy-engine[docs]",
  "policy-engine[lint]",
  "policy-engine[mutation]",
  "policy-engine[notebooks]",
  "policy-engine[structured-logging]",
]
# Curated umbrella used by docs/onboarding.
# It intentionally excludes externally provisioned or highly platform-specific
# paths such as `apple-metal`, `causal-bcf`, and `causal-symbolic-r`, plus
# heavyweight local-only tooling and overlap-heavy milestone bundles that slow
# pip's resolver dramatically without adding new capability surface.
all = [
  "policy-engine[research]",
  "policy-engine[hotreload]",
  "policy-engine[rag]",
  "policy-engine[runtime]",
  "policy-engine[security]",
  "policy-engine[shapesafe]",
]
structured-logging = ["structlog>=24.0.0"]
search_bo = [
  "torch>=2.0.0",
  "gpytorch>=1.11",
  "botorch>=0.9.0",
  "linear_operator>=0.5.0",
  "scipy>=1.10.0",
]
search_mo = [
  "torch>=2.0.0",
  "gpytorch>=1.11",
  "botorch>=0.9.0",
  "linear_operator>=0.5.0",
  "scipy>=1.10.0",
]

[project.scripts]
polisy = "polisyos.foundry.plugins.cli:main"
polisyos = "tools.ops_runners.runtime_cli:main"
polisyos-causal-capabilities = "polisyos.foundry.methods.catalog.causal.capabilities:main"
polisyos-foundry = "tools.ops_runners.runtime_cli:foundry_main"
polisyos-tools = "tools.cli:main"
ukraine-data = "polisyos.data_forge.domains.ukraine.cli:main"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
  "libcst>=1.5.0",
  # Plain `uv run pytest` must use the same prerequisites as contributor/CI tests.
  "policy-engine[test]",
]
# Give uv modern wheel-bearing Pillow/regex resolutions while retaining Marker's
# older branch. Keep this group non-default so `--all-extras --dev` stays compatible.
ci = ["pillow>=12", "regex>=2026.9.3"]

[tool.uv]
conflicts = [[{extra = "table-extraction"}, {group = "ci"}]]

[tool.uv.sources]
# The universal wheel packages the unchanged upstream 1.4.1 Python sources.
# Vendored; provenance and verification in vendor/wheels/README.md.
odfpy = { path = "vendor/wheels/odfpy-1.4.1-py2.py3-none-any.whl" }

[project.entry-points."polisyos.fabric_connectors"]
"worldbank.wdi" = "polisyos.fabric.connectors.components:world_bank_connector_component"
"wvs.wave7" = "polisyos.fabric.connectors.components:wvs_connector_component"
"eurostat.data" = "polisyos.fabric.connectors.components:eurostat_connector_component"
"ukons.datasets" = "polisyos.fabric.connectors.components:ukons_connector_component"
"sdmx.source" = "polisyos.fabric.connectors.components:sdmx_connector_component"
"ckan.catalog" = "polisyos.fabric.connectors.components:ckan_catalog_connector_component"
"ckan.resource" = "polisyos.fabric.connectors.components:ckan_resource_connector_component"
"socrata.soda" = "polisyos.fabric.connectors.components:socrata_connector_component"
"opendatasoft.ods" = "polisyos.fabric.connectors.components:opendatasoft_connector_component"
"sparql.endpoint" = "polisyos.fabric.connectors.components:sparql_connector_component"
"rest.json" = "polisyos.fabric.connectors.components:rest_json_connector_component"


[project.entry-points."polisyos.scientist_governance_passes"]
"budget" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:budget_pass_factory"
"causal_frontier_leakage" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:causal_frontier_leakage_pass_factory"
"checkpoint" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:checkpoint_pass_factory"
"schema" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:schema_pass_factory"
"privacy" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:privacy_pass_factory"
"pii_check" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:pii_check_pass_factory"
"freshness" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:freshness_pass_factory"
"sutva_check" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:sutva_check_pass_factory"
"transportability_required" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:transportability_required_pass_factory"
"safety" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:safety_pass_factory"
"equity" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:equity_pass_factory"
"cross_graph_evidence" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:cross_graph_evidence_pass_factory"
"fabric_trust" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:fabric_trust_gate_pass_factory"
"incentive_compatibility" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:incentive_compatibility_pass_factory"
"literature_gate" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:literature_gate_pass_factory"
"legal" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:legal_pass_factory"
"confidence" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:confidence_pass_factory"
"refutation" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:refutation_pass_factory"
"human_review_required" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:human_review_required_pass_factory"
"quality" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:quality_gate_pass_factory"
"normative_arbitration" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:normative_arbitration_pass_factory"
"strategic_response" = "polisyos.scientist.governance.pass_entrypoints:strategic_response_pass_factory"

[project.entry-points."polisyos.foundry_methods"]
"polisyos.foundry.builtin_catalog" = "polisyos.foundry.extensions._builtin_loader:builtin_foundry_method_components"

[project.entry-points."polisyos.scientist_nodes"]
# External packages declare one ComponentProvider per Scientist node here.
# Builtins are registered through polisyos.scientist.nodes.components:builtin_node_components.

[project.entry-points."polisyos.data_forge_domains"]

[project.entry-points."polisyos.lex_normpacks"]

[project.entry-points."polisyos.runtime_middlewares"]
# Build configuration lives in hatch.toml.
